title: P1-5 mechanism-matched RFKD comparator for Scientific Reports revised manuscript
paper_of_record: Residual Feature-Driven Knowledge Distillation for Reliable Open-Set Scene Understanding Under Distribution Shift, Electronics 15(16), 3556 (2026), DOI 10.3390/electronics15163556
formal_manuscript_basis: Cross-Score Uncertainty Transfer via Asymmetric Distillation for OOD Detection; original source narrative takes precedence over early draft awareKD1

methods_description.RFKD_EnergyOrder_T1_PublishedSpec: Teacher confidence+entropy from T=1 softmax; teacher ranking -logsumexp raw; student h(f) ranking alpha=0.
methods_description.RFKD_EnergyOrder_T6_Matched: Teacher confidence+entropy from T=6 softmax; teacher ranking -logsumexp raw; student h(f) ranking alpha=0. Same as matched B2 T6 CrossScore except teacher order target is Energy not 1-MSP.

primary_contrast: CIFAR100 five-seed difference in average Energy AUROC over all six OOD domains: CrossScore_T6_Corrected minus RFKD_EnergyOrder_T6_Matched, paired by seed; show exact sign-flip p and raw five seed differences. No generalization claim from n=5.
secondary: CIFAR10 six OOD domain AUROC and FPR95, CIFAR100 domain heterogeneity; T1 comparison; ID validation accuracy differences, compute cost.
statistical_caveat: 5 paired seeds two-sided sign-flip p lower bound .0625
architecture: CIFAR style ResNet18 student and fixed ResNet50 teacher, identical B2 checkpoint, 200 epochs, batch128 SGD .1 momentum .9 weight decay .0005 cosine
reuse: Existing B2 CE/VanillaKD/CrossScore T1/T6 40 trained models unchanged; train RFKD only
OOD_score: negative logsumexp student logits, higher OOD
stopping_rule: If any mismatch in teacher hash, model initial hash, split, GPU lease, checksum or preliminary scientific ambiguity, stop and audit before remaining 16.
disclosure_caveats: This is a mechanism-matched reimplementation, not an authenticated reproduction of official published RFKD original runs.
Energy target and T6 teacher confidence settings differ from T1 published RFKD main configuration.
Train/validation CIFAR split follows B2, not necessarily the publication setup; use as a controlled factorial under one protocol.
CrossScore publication novelty must be distinguished from already published overlapping RFKD contributions explicitly.
